name: Twinings Pure Chamomile Herbal Tea (Caffeine-Free Antispasmodic)
whyItWorks: Chamomile contains the bioflavonoid apigenin, which binds to benzodiazepine receptors in the nervous system and exerts natural antispasmodic and muscle-relaxant effects on the gastrointestinal tract, easing colonic cramps.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Steep 1 tea bag in 8 oz boiling water for 4–5 minutes. Sip warm before bedtime or during cramps.
